providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.limits: 50 free-model requests/day per account (free tier); models priced $0

providers.name: Google Gemini (AI Studio)
providers.limits: Free tier, no card required. Community-measured: Flash models roughly 10 RPM and up to ~1,500 requests/day depending on model. Free-tier prompts may be used by Google to improve products; a project with billing enabled loses the free tier.

providers.name: Groq
providers.limits: Free tier: headline ~1,000 requests/day per model, but a ~200K tokens/day cap (community tables) makes it run dry after a few long agent turns. Best for short tasks.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
providers.limits: Developer program free credits: community tables list ~40 RPM and up to 10,000 requests/day per model - unusually generous; verify on your own account.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.limits: 10,000 Neurons/day free - roughly 4M input tokens/day on small models; the largest renewable free token pool, but you bring your own gateway/adapter.

providers.name: Zhipu GLM Flash (BigModel)
providers.limits: Flash-series endpoints are free (rate-limited to ~1 concurrent request). Requires a real-name verified account (China).

providers.name: ModelScope (魔搭)
providers.limits: Free inference API, community-reported ~2,000 calls/day. Requires Alibaba Cloud binding + real-name verification (China).

providers.name: SiliconFlow (硅基流动)
providers.limits: A subset of models (mostly smaller Qwen/GLM/DeepSeek distillations) is free. Requires real-name verification (China).

providers.name: Mistral (La Plateforme)
providers.limits: Not a free tier: the Experiment plan includes monthly free credit (~$10 reported). Codestral is a strong free-ish coding option while credit lasts.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.limits: Not a free tier: $5 trial credit, expires in 30 days, card required. Extremely fast inference while it lasts.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.limits: Truly unlimited: runs on your own machine - no key, no quota, no data leaving the device. Quality/speed bounded by your hardware.
providers.note: Roster becomes real when OLLAMA_HOST is set: refresh lists the models actually installed on that machine.

providers.name: OpenCode Zen (DeepSeek free)
providers.limits: deepseek-v4.1-flash-free is free for a limited time but only inside the OpenCode app - direct API calls are rejected (FreeTierError). Anonymous quota is shared per IP and was exhausted in the maintainer's test.
providers.note: Not API-probeable by design; listed so the roster is complete and honest about it.
